newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Eagle lifts stake in Tai Shan Prop.
newsitem.headline: Great Eagle lifts stake in Tai Shan Prop.

text.p: Great Eagle Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it has agreed to buy 22.5 million shares of its spinoff and listing candidate Tai Shan Properties Ltd for not more than HK$260 million.

Great Eagle said its holding in Tai Shan would be increased to 74.65 percent from 73.15 percent following its purchase of the stake from Citicorp Financial Services Ltd (CFSL), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Citibank NA.
CFSL's stake in Tai Shan will be reduced to 1.39 percent from 2.89 after the deal, the statement said.
Great Eagle said it would fund the purchase by internal resources.

The blue-chip property group said Tai Shan had also agreed to buy a property management company, Longworth Management Ltd, for HK$16 million. Longworth is owned 80.01 percent by a unit of Great Eagle and 19.99 percent by CSFL, it said.
Market sources said Tai Shan is seen issuing 225 million shares at HK$10.60 to HK$11.45 per share.
The Hong Kong flotation is seen running from March 4-7, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on March 14.
